verdict.rationale: EmailOctopus's API documents upserts (create or update), bulk contact updates, creating list fields for custom properties, and rate limits of 10 requests per second with bursts up to 100, so create/update with custom fields at some scale is supported. Suppression or unsubscribe via the API is never explicitly shown, and the stated rate limit caps production throughput. Missing for 10: documented API suppression/unsubscribe of contacts, explicit setting of custom field values on contacts, bulk-create limits or throughput guidance beyond the rate limit, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale

citations.quote: An upsert allows you to either update the entity if it exists or create a new one if it doesn't.
This system enables a steady request rate of up to 10 per second or a burst of up to 100 requests in a single instance if needed.
